categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in television broadcasting, including the establishment and operation of TV broadcast systems, production and distribution of TV programs, TV advertising, international TV program retransmission, and related TV engineering services. It also engages in digital media platform cooperation and development, content licensing, and integrated marketing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced HD and 4K video production technologies, including 4K cameras, non-linear editing systems, and digital storage solutions. It integrates AI technologies for post-production enhancements such as visual packaging, image restoration, and automated speech recognition with real-time translation for subtitles. The company also uses virtual studios with 3D virtual scenes and has implemented ISO27001 information security management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic and international satellite TV stations, OTT and IPTV platforms, cable TV operators, advertising agencies, and corporate advertisers mainly from the domestic market. The company targets general viewers across various demographics with news, drama, variety shows, and reality programs, and also serves overseas Chinese communities through content licensing and digital platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, covering Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu regions. It also extends its content distribution and licensing to international markets including Southeast Asia, Hong Kong, Singapore, China, and other overseas Chinese communities. Digital content is distributed globally via platforms like YouTube and Facebook.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream as a television broadcaster and content producer, sourcing programs from in-house production, commissioned producers, co-productions, investments, and external purchases. It supplies content downstream to cable operators, OTT platforms, and advertisers, while upstream it collaborates with equipment suppliers and content creators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include upgrading to 4K and HD production capabilities, expanding digital and OTT platform presence, and enhancing AI applications in content production and broadcasting. The company focuses on developing high-quality original content, strengthening news production with digital newsroom systems, and expanding multi-platform distribution. It also emphasizes ESG initiatives, including climate risk management and sustainable operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through television advertising sales, program licensing and copyright sales to domestic and international broadcasters and digital platforms, integrated marketing projects, and digital advertising on owned websites and social media channels. Additional income comes from equipment and studio rental services and content distribution partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading free-to-air broadcasters in Taiwan, ranking second in viewership among the four major terrestrial TV stations. It competes with other major broadcasters and faces increasing competition from cable, OTT, and digital media platforms. Its strong news brand and diversified content portfolio provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported net operating revenues of approximately NT$899.6 million in 2024, a decrease from the previous year, with an operating loss of NT$73.9 million and a net loss after tax of NT$35.2 million. Total assets were about NT$5.38 billion with equity of NT$2.24 billion. The company has experienced revenue decline and increased losses recently but continues to invest in digital transformation and content development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, diverse programming including news, drama, variety, and reality shows with strong viewer loyalty. It differentiates through advanced HD and 4K production, AI-enhanced post-production, and a robust digital content library. Its trusted news brand, comprehensive multi-platform distribution, and commitment to social responsibility and ESG principles further enhance its market position.
